test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Consider the below statements and identify the correct answer.

**Statement - I :** The chemical formula of bleaching powder is Ca(OCl)₂.

**Statement - II :** It is used to make drinking water free from germs.

options.text: Statement - II is true, and Statement - I is false.
Statement - I is true, and Statement - II is false.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Both the statements are true.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Bleaching powder:**

 
• It is also known as **calcium hypochlorite.**
 
• It is commonly **used as a disinfectant.**
